create_meta_data_generator: create a MetaDataGenerator that combines multiple data generators into a single batched generator
sample_params_meta_generator: sample parameters from a MetaDataGenerator for a given batch size across all child generators
sample_from_params_meta_generator: sample sequences, probabilities, and logs from a MetaDataGenerator using pre-generated parameters
check_batch_size_seq_length: validate that child generator batch sizes sum to the meta batch size and all sequence lengths match
get_feature_size_meta_generator: get the maximum feature size across all child generators in a MetaDataGenerator
